observations.why: Settled confirmation of successful calibration — the speaker reports verification that holds, carrying low-arousal satisfaction without enthusiasm or urgency.
Neutral labelling field with no affective charge; at most carries the quiet confidence of a completed record, but the signal is thin — borderline unmarked.
Summary field reiterating verification status in a settled, matter-of-fact register — low-arousal positive confidence, no activation.
